parts.text: Evaluate the CURRENT Agents.md and CURRENT send-to-gemini.js specifically for the supervisory gating defect identified by the user, then produce a revised complete replacement send-to-gemini.js that corrects the defect while preserving the rest of the current procedure behavior. The user states that the supervisory return schema should begin unevaluated, with evaluative/result fields initialized to null rather than pre-populated as PASS/FAIL or otherwise prompting the supervisor toward a result. The supervisor semantic operation should receive the execution return plus the unevaluated supervisory schema/template, perform the evaluation, fill the schema, and only then may the controller inspect the resulting exact transition key defined by Agents.md. Determine the correct implementation from the canonical Agents.md rather than merely accepting this wording mechanically. In particular, evaluate whether the current prompt construction improperly asks Gemini to manufacture a completed supervisory schema without being anchored to an unevaluated schema/template, and whether the controller is merely validating the presence of PASS/FAIL instead of enforcing the intended gate procedure. Correct all material gating discrepancies you find. Preserve Bootstrap/run_nonce isolation, per-run state/messages/store persistence, Step 3 evaluation-document requirements, Step 3 internal loop semantics, restart-on-FAIL behavior, and missing/invalid-return repair behavior unless the canonical procedure requires a change. Return the entire non-truncated replacement send-to-gemini.js source, not a patch, with no markdown fences or explanatory prose.
